title: Daily standup
description: Overnight alerts, open PRs, today's focus, tickets needing a second look. Runs off [How We Work](how-we-work.md). 30 minutes, standing, in [Rila](room:Rila).

title: New joiner welcome
description: Badges, laptops and a tour for [Maria Nikolova](user:maria@uniffy.io). Bring questions on the [First Week Checklist](first-week-checklist.md) and [Systems and Access](systems-and-access.md).

title: Sprint planning: Uniffy Cloud
description: Two week sprint for cloud.uniffy.io. Theme is onboarding flow copy, measured against [Voice and Tone](voice-and-tone.md).

title: GDPR and customer data refresher
description: Mandatory yearly session with the DPO on [Customer Data Protection Policy](customer-data-protection-policy.md): retention, subject requests, the 72-hour breach clock. Register reviewed live from [data-processing-register.csv](file:Compliance/data-processing-register.csv).

title: QA regression day, Plovdiv
description: Full regression sweep on the device lab before the release cut. Booked builds only, no ad-hoc installs. Logistics in the [Plovdiv Office Guide](plovdiv-office-guide.md).

title: Team leads sync
description: Sofia and Plovdiv leads in [Iskar](room:Iskar): review rotation, ticket queues, hardware, hiring, courier timings from the [Plovdiv Office Guide](plovdiv-office-guide.md).

title: Security review board
description: Incident review and control changes per the [Incident Response Runbook](incident-response-runbook.md). Security lead chairs, in [Vitosha](room:Vitosha).

title: Community webinar evening
description: Open session for self-hosted admins on upgrades and backups. [Trakia Training Room](room:Trakia Training Room) is blocked from 17:00.

title: Board meeting
description: Quarterly numbers, Plovdiv office expansion, security audit status against the [Information Security Policy](information-security-policy.md).

title: Quarterly all-hands
description: Where we are against the plan, what changed in the product, questions taken live and remote. Grounded in [Mission and Values](mission-and-values.md).

title: Release review
description: Rollbacks, deploy durations, SLO breaches and flaky suites, against [service-slo-reference.csv](file:Engineering/service-slo-reference.csv) and the [Release and Deploy Runbook](release-and-deploy-runbook.md).

title: Incident response drill
description: Tabletop exercise in [Serdica](room:Serdica): a mock sev1 run end to end against the [Incident Response Runbook](incident-response-runbook.md). Mandatory yearly for on-call staff, training days per [Leave and Time Off](leave-and-time-off-policy.md).

title: Hack day
description: One day to build anything on Uniffy, demos at 16:00 in the ground floor lobby. Drop in, no sign-up. Parking and access notes in the [Sofia HQ Guide](sofia-hq-guide.md).
